prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Pearland, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1211; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give you the facts of what happened, if that's okay.
Q: Of course. Can you describe where the accident took place and what you were doing?
A: It was at an intersection in Pearland, Texas. I was driving through on a green light, heading straight across the main road.
Q: What was the traffic signal showing when you entered the intersection?
A: Green for me. I'm certain of that because I'd been waiting at the light and it just changed.
Q: What happened next?
A: A pickup truck coming from my right ran the red light and hit the driver's side of my car. Well, the front passenger side, actually. It struck my door area pretty hard.
Q: Did you have any chance to brake or swerve?
A: Not really. It came out of nowhere. I hit the brakes as soon as I saw it, but there wasn't time.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: How are you feeling since the accident?
A: My neck is stiff and sore, and my lower back aches, especially when I sit for a while. I've been taking over-the-counter pain relievers.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same day and I'm scheduled for physical therapy.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I've been careful and I didn't do anything to cause this. That's all I have.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
